title: HECM Line Kept for the Next Property Tax Bill
content:
Added to the amounts kept for the draw ceiling of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM): Cedarline keeps in the line for the draw ceiling the next property tax bill it last had to advance.

1. When Cedarline advanced property tax on the loan — a property tax advance recorded under the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment records — on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, the tax renewal reserve is the total of the property tax advanced in that window.
2. When no property tax was advanced in that window but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual property tax above 0.00, the tax renewal reserve is that annual property tax.
3. Otherwise the tax renewal reserve is 0.00.

**The twelve-month window, both sides (hypothetical handling date 10 June).** A property tax advance paid on 11 June of the previous year is inside the window; one paid on 10 June of the previous year is not.

**Illustrations (hypothetical figures).**

| Property tax advanced in the window | Depleted set-aside, annual property tax | Tax renewal reserve |
|---|---|---|
| 2100.00 and 900.00 | any | 3000.00 |
| none | 2400.00 | 2400.00 |
| none | 0.00, or no depleted set-aside | 0.00 |
